rounds.prompt: If all the gold ever mined were melted into a single cube, how long would one side be?
rounds.source: World Gold Council above-ground stocks (222,600 tonnes at end-Q2 2026), whose own page puts the resulting cube at about 22.6 metres a side

rounds.prompt: How many servings of instant noodles were eaten around the world in 2025?
rounds.source: World Instant Noodles Association (WINA) global demand figures, released August 2026: 124.21 billion servings in 2025, led by China/Hong Kong (43.27 billion), Indonesia (14.54 billion) and India (9.60 billion)

rounds.prompt: How many people have ever run a mile in under four minutes?
rounds.source: World Athletics all-time one mile toplist (men, indoor and outdoor): 2,253 athletes under 4:00 as of September 2026. No woman has broken four minutes.
